claims.content: The user must not be currently logged in to the system.
The user must be on the Sign-In page (or a page that links to it).
The user must click the 'New? Register Here' link to initiate the registration process.
A new customer account is created in the system with the status 'Pending' (or similar, awaiting email verification).
The user's email address is recorded in the system.
An automated email containing a unique validation link is sent to the user's provided email address.
The user is redirected to a confirmation page informing them that an email has been sent and that they must click the link to activate their account.
The user is not yet able to log in or access member-only features until the email link is clicked.
